validation_scope: software output and completion; correction additionally requires package/protocol/integrity/capture checks; detection has no equivalent sequenced-result or per-checker work counters

packages.scope: full captured protected session; accepted BOOM-domain results, not local done
packages.ROI_work_drain_scope: all packages allocated before application end, including start boundary package; later STOP packages excluded

full_session_checker_work.scope: entire protected session, including four packages crossing software ROI; counter interval validated for every BOOM-accepted result; management/boundary instructions can differ from hart0 rdinstret

protocol.end_policy: STOP may retain WB_WAIT; exit with retained entries is not proof of full durable drain

summary.event_storage: priority reserved TSV; explicit loss accounting; bounded final JSON

cache_opportunity.candidate_policy: traffic hypothesis only; per-level S0 sanity, critical-path evidence, hardware cost and real validation required

sourcec.interpretation: overlapping activity counts on the new schedule; not causal ROI savings

terminal_snapshots.scope: hardware traffic-enable window, local clock counts; overlapping activity, not causal savings

checker_profile.scope: checker-local priority partition for complete captured packages inside ROI; optional loss excludes packages, not zero-filled; not causal BOOM savings
checker_profile.active_capacity_fraction_scope: lower bound from complete packages wholly inside ROI; denominator four checkers at half BOOM clock, 4*ROI/2; excludes four boundary packages

cancelled_snapshot_counter_scope: UNOBSERVED: new diagnostic printf remains verbose-gated in this build; zero captured lines is not a zero event count
